training: exact A/B/C tier-specific frozen cold-v4 fit source identities and low-extinction cuts

distance_modulus_prior.interpretation: fixed experiment prior, equivalent to p(distance) proportional to 1/distance within bounds

configuration_score: equal-field mean of held-out conditional negative log density for observed Mg given observed colors and measurement covariance
comparison: same Gaia strict anchors accepted by the frozen grz_clean + WISE20 route, preserving chosen A/B/C tier and all support/type-risk states

candidate_gate.decision_if_gate_fails: retain frozen v4 and close this limited model comparison

independent_final_rule: Only if a single candidate passes the development gate: lock its artifact/hash, then use separately registered calibration and one new final sky field; no previously inspected field is blind.
